description_en: Migrates an ApsaraDB RDS instance to a different zone
description_zh: 该接口用于迁移RDS实例的可用区
kebab_example: aliyun rds migrate-to-other-zone --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --region cn-hangzhou
name: MigrateToOtherZone

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID. The VPC cannot be changed during instance migration and must remain the same.

This parameter is required when you migrate a VPC-connected instance to a different zone.
If the instance engine is SQL Server, the VPC can be changed during instance migration
parameters.help_zh:
专有网络VPC ID。迁移可用区时VPC不能变更，需保持不变。

专有网络实例迁移可用区时必须传入该参数。
如果实例引擎为SQL Server，迁移可用区VPC可支持变更
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination zone. You can call DescribeRegions to query the zone ID
parameters.help_zh: 目标可用区ID，可调用DescribeRegions获取
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The effective period. Valid values:
Immediate: The migration takes effect immediately. This is the default value.
MaintainTime: The migration takes effect during the maintenance window. For more information, see ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime.
ScheduleTime: The migration takes effect at a custom time.

If you set this parameter to ScheduleTime, you must also specify the SwitchTime parameter
parameters.help_zh:
生效时间，取值：
Immediate：默认值，立即生效。
MaintainTime：在可运维时间段内生效，请参见ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime。
ScheduleTime：手动指定生效时间。

如果在本参数中传入ScheduleTime，则还需要传入SwitchTime参数
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch ID.
This parameter is required when you migrate a VPC-connected instance to a different zone. You can invoke DescribeVSwitches to query the vSwitches that have been created.
When you perform instance migration for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL or SQL Server instance to a different zone with a secondary zone configured, you can specify multiple vSwitch IDs separated by commas (,), corresponding to the zones
parameters.help_zh:
交换机ID。
专有网络实例迁移可用区时必须传入该参数。可通过调用DescribeVSwitches接口查询已创建的交换机。
当RDS PostgreSQL、SQL Server实例迁移可用区配置了备可用区时，此参数可以配置多个，用英文逗号（,）分隔，与可用区对应
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance edition. Valid values:

Basic: Basic Edition
HighAvailability: High-availability Edition
AlwaysOn: SQL Server Cluster Edition
cluster: MySQL Cluster Edition
Finance: RDS Enterprise Edition
parameters.help_zh:
实例系列，取值：

Basic：基础系列
HighAvailability：高可用系列
AlwaysOn：SQL Server集群系列
cluster：MySQL集群系列
Finance：三节点企业系列
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The secondary zone 1.
This parameter is required for instances that are not of the Basic Edition
parameters.help_zh:
备可用区1。
非基础系列实例需要传入该参数
parameters.name: zone_id_slave_1

parameters.help_en:
The secondary zone 2.
This parameter is applicable only to RDS Enterprise Edition instances
parameters.help_zh:
备可用区2。
仅三节点企业系列实例可传入该参数
parameters.name: zone_id_slave_2

parameters.help_en: The custom time at which the zone switch takes effect. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). This parameter is used together with the EffectiveTime parameter and is required only when EffectiveTime is set to ScheduleTime
parameters.help_zh: 切换可用区的自定义生效时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 本参数配合EffectiveTime参数使用，仅在EffectiveTime为ScheduleTime时需要传入
parameters.name: switch_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to change the instance specifications during zone migration.

true: Change the specifications. When this parameter is set to true, you must specify at least one of the DBInstanceClass and DBInstanceStorage parameters.
false: Do not change the specifications. This is the default value.

This parameter is applicable only to ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances
parameters.help_zh:
是否在迁移可用区时变配。

true：变配，当配置为true时，至少需要配置DBInstanceClass或DBInstanceStorage中的一个参数。
false：默认值，不变配。

该参数仅RDS MySQL实例适用
parameters.name: is_modify_spec

parameters.help_en:
The target instance type of the destination instance. Only the instance type can be changed. The storage type cannot be changed.
When the IsModifySpec parameter settings require true, you must specify at least one of this parameter and DBInstanceStorage.

For more information about instance types, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/276975.html
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例规格代码，只支持变更规格，不支持变更存储类型。
当IsModifySpec参数配置为true时，至少需要配置本参数和DBInstanceStorage中的一个。

实例规格代码请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/276975.html
parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.help_en:
The destination storage capacity. When the IsModifySpec parameter settings require true, you must specify at least one of this parameter and DBInstanceClass.

Unit: GB.
Valid values: The storage capacity varies based on the instance type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/276975.html
parameters.help_zh:
目标存储空间大小。当IsModifySpec参数配置为true时，至少需要配置本参数和DBInstanceClass中的一个。

单位：GB。
取值范围：不同规格可扩容存储空间大小不同，具体请以https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/276975.html为准
parameters.name: db_instance_storage

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the Buffer Pool Extension (BPE) feature for premium performance disks. Valid values:

1: Enable.
0: Disable.

For more information about the BPE feature, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527067.html
parameters.help_zh:
高性能云盘的Buffer Pool Extension（BPE）功能开关，参数：

1：开启
0：不开启

Buffer Pool Extension（BPE）功能的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527067.html
parameters.name: io_acceleration_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The instance storage type. Valid values:
cloud_essd: PL1 ESSD cloud disk.
cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD cloud disk.
cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD cloud disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD (not recommended because standard SSDs are no longer available for purchase in some regions)
parameters.help_zh:
实例存储类型，取值：
cloud_essd：ESSD PL1 云盘。
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2 云盘。
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3 云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘（不推荐，部分地域已经停止售卖）
parameters.name: db_instance_storage_type

OrderId.description_en: The order ID. This parameter is applicable only to ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances
